## What changed

## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional commit messages; branch follows gitflow (`feature/*` into `develop`)
- [ ] Piece README, DEMO.md, root README status table, CHANGELOG and docs/video-map.md are current
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated; coverage stays at or above 90% for the piece
- [ ] `/simplify` was run on the diff and its findings applied
- [ ] No network calls in tests; LLM calls go through the shared interface
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or real account IDs in the diff
- [ ] Any statistic cited in docs is listed in `docs/sources.md`
- [ ] Compliance mappings are labeled "illustrative mapping, not a compliance attestation"
